positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the firm's core data platform, from transaction processing to an LLM-powered knowledge base over its email archive.
achievements: Designed and deployed a full-stack transaction processing system on PostgreSQL/Supabase with a Retool frontend, replacing 80+ interlinked spreadsheet workflows and migrating client data.
Engineered SQL triggers for regular caching of account balances and automated fee generation for each transaction.

Built an end-to-end intelligence pipeline: turned the firm's 100K+ message email archive into an entity-resolved corpus, an identity/relationship graph validated against independent data sources, an LLM-based knowledge extraction pipeline, and a LanceDB RAG layer for custom Q&A.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description: First engineer on a platform where New Yorkers give away and find free items on a live map.
achievements: Developed and deployed a full-stack web application with Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, allowing users in NYC to browse and post free items via an interactive Leaflet.js map.
Containerized the application with Docker multi-stage builds and Docker Compose, decoupling frontend and backend into isolated services with persistent volumes.
Replaced duplicated user data in listing records with ID references resolved through GraphQL, so 500+ existing listings always display current user profiles without needing a schema migration.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Built the transportation scheduling platform for a Brooklyn recycling non-profit, end to end.
achievements: Led end-to-end development of a scalable transportation scheduling platform for a Brooklyn non-profit, engineering the system with React/TypeScript, Node.js/Express, and MongoDB to securely support 100+ active users across NYC.
Architected and deployed 20+ secure REST API endpoints backed by a 5-layer middleware stack, built for fault tolerance and scalability under concurrent load.

Integrated third-party microservices (Twilio, Google Maps) to power real-time logistics tracking and automated notifications, enforcing access control and security standards through a role-based React Admin interface.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: Used marketing and enrollment data to cut acquisition costs and speed up KPI reporting.
achievements: Performed marketing ROI analysis to optimize channel allocation (Google Ads/Facebook/Instagram), driving a 30% reduction in cost-per-admission and a 20% increase in student enrollment.

Engineered a centralized data pipeline and Power BI dashboard system to track core business KPIs, reducing reporting time from weekly to daily and enabling real-time data-driven decision making by the C-suite.
